name: FCX/NEM Pairs Trade — Copper Regime Filter
description: Mean reversion pairs trade: long FCX / short NEM when FCX/NEM price ratio z-score (90-day) is below -2.0, filtered by copper-favorable regime (HG/GC ratio above 200d SMA). Persistent entry (level-based, not crossunder) ensures signals aren't missed on single-bar regime misalignment. Hold 63 days with 15% stop loss per leg. 10% position sizing per leg.
source:
# FCX/NEM Pairs Trade — Copper Regime Filtered Mean Reversion
# Signal: 90-day z-score of FCX/NEM ratio < -2.0 (persistent, not crossunder)
# Filter: HG/GC ratio > 200d SMA (copper-favorable regime)
# Direction: Long FCX, Short NEM simultaneously
# Hold: 63 bars, strict_hold prevents re-entry during hold window
# Exit: 15% stop loss per leg
# Sizing: 10% of equity per leg

# --- Data Sources ---
# Primary asset OHLCV (FCX in FCX context, NEM in NEM context)
src = market_data_source()()

# Reference data for ratio computation (shared context — identical in both asset contexts)
fcx_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
fcx_ref_close = ffill(fcx_ref.c)
nem_ref_close = ffill(nem_ref.c)

# Reference: HG (copper futures) — NoAdjustment for ratio analysis
hg_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)

# Reference: GC (gold futures) — NoAdjustment for ratio analysis
gc_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- FCX/NEM Price Ratio & Z-Score ---
fcx_nem_ratio = fcx_ref_close / nem_ref_close
ratio_z = zscore(window=90)(fcx_nem_ratio)

# --- Copper Regime Filter ---
# HG/GC ratio above its 200-day SMA = copper outperforming gold
hg_gc_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
hg_gc_ma200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(hg_gc_ratio)
copper_regime = hg_gc_ratio > hg_gc_ma200

# --- Entry Signal (PERSISTENT, not crossunder) ---
# Fires on ANY bar where z-score < -2.0 AND copper regime is favorable
# hold_long/hold_short=63 with strict_hold=True prevents re-entry during hold
# This naturally limits to one trade per signal cluster
signal = ratio_z < -2.0 and copper_regime

# --- Asset-Specific Direction ---
# FCX context: go long (ratio is cheap → FCX undervalued vs NEM)
# NEM context: go short (the other leg of the pairs trade)
is_fcx = is_asset_ref(ticker='FCX')()
is_nem = is_asset_ref(ticker='NEM')()

long_entry = signal and is_fcx
short_entry = signal and is_nem

# --- Execution ---
# rollover_policy required by validator when futures_continuation is present
# FCX/NEM are stocks — this is a no-op pass-through
rollover_policy()(active=src.s)

# Wiring order: rollover → zone → sizing → exits
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=63, hold_short=63, strict_hold=True)(
    long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry
)

# 10% of equity per leg
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)

# 15% stop loss per leg — early exit if individual leg moves against us
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=15)

# --- Regime Change Event Markers ---
# Mark when copper regime flips (not trade entries — those are auto-generated)
regime_on = crossover(hg_gc_ratio, hg_gc_ma200)
regime_off = crossunder(hg_gc_ratio, hg_gc_ma200)
regime_change = regime_on or regime_off
regime_label = conditional_select(regime_on, "Copper Favorable", "Copper Unfavorable")

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Copper Regime Change',
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='HG/GC Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='200d MA', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX/NEM Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, hg_gc_ratio, hg_gc_ma200, ratio_z, regime_change)
